segments.text:
I.
WELL have I weigh'd it, Lord, and find
Thy mighty Paſſion mocks my Skill:
Tho' I die for Thee, I'm behind;
My Sins deſerve the Death to feel.

II.
O were I innocent, that I
Might bring Thee Off'rings pure and free!
Still my Attempt thy Wounds defy,
For they require me dead for Thee.

III.
Yet will I ſhare the Conqueſt too:
Tho' I can do againſt Thee nought,
In Thee, O Lord, I will ſubdue
The Man that once againſt Thee fought!
